title: Covariance and Pearson Correlation
learning_objectives: Compute Pearson's r and interpret its range
Recognise that correlation measures only linear association
hints: Compute both means, then `sxy = sum((a - mx) * (b - my) for a, b in zip(x, y))`.
r = `sxy / math.sqrt(sxx * syy)`; raise if `sxx` or `syy` is 0.

failure_feedback.advice: Sample covariance divides the sum of deviation products by n − 1.
r measures linear association only; y = x² on symmetric x gives 0.
A constant variable has zero spread — raise ValueError.
Centre both variables before multiplying deviations.
